```artifact
Feature: Doctor, Chemist, and Lab Management

  Background:
    As a backend system handling medical records
    As an integral part of the healthcare management software
    I want to ensure the integrity and proper handling of doctor, chemist, and lab data

  Scenario: Add a new unique Doctor
    Given a new doctor registration form is presented
    When the user submits the form with Name, Age, Sex, Qualification, and Experience
    Then the system should create a new doctor record
    And the doctor's details should be retrievable

  Scenario: Ensure Doctor' extraneous details cannot be updated
    Given a doctor's details are already registered
    When the user attempts to update the Speciality
    Then the system should reject the update

  Scenario: Delete a Doctor's details
    Given a doctor's details are registered and no pending Patient Consultation Request
    When the user requests to delete the doctor
    Then the system should remove the doctor's details
    And confirm the deletion

  Scenario: Maintain Chemist & Lab Details

    Background:
      As a backend system handling medical records
      As an integral part of the healthcare management software
      I want to ensure the integrity and proper handling of chemist and lab data

    Scenario: Add a new Chemist or Lab
      Given a request to add a new Chemist or Lab
      When the user submits the form with required details
      Then the system should create a new Chemist or Lab record
      And ensure there is only one Chemist or Lab per Pincode

    Scenario: View and Update Chemist/Lab Details
      Given a Chemist/Lab record is displayed
      When the user submits updates to the details
      Then the system should update the Chemist/Lab record
      And ensure the Pincode for the Chemist/Lab remains unchanged

    Scenario: Delete a Chemist/Lab Details
      Given a Chemist/Lab record is registered and no pending Prescription
      When the user requests to delete the Chemist/Lab
      Then the system should remove the Chemist/Lab record
      And confirm the deletion

# JSON Test Cases
[
  {"id": "TC-001", "title": "Add a new unique Doctor", "req_ids": ["U12_4"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": [], "inputs": {"name": "string", "age": "number", "sex": "string", "qualification": "string", "experience": "string"}, "steps": ["Present registration form", "Submit form", "Create doctor record", "Retrieve doctor details"], "expected": ["Record created", "Details retrievable"]},
  {"id": "TC-002", "title": "Ensure Doctor extraneous details cannot be updated", "req_ids": ["U12_4"], "kind": "negative", "preconditions": ["Doctor's details registered"], "inputs": {}, "steps": ["Attempt to update Speciality", "Expect rejection"], "expected": ["Update rejected"]},
  {"id": "TC-003", "title": "Delete a Doctor's details", "req_ids": ["U12_4"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": ["Doctor's details registered", "No pending Patient Consultation Request"], "inputs": {}, "steps": ["Request deletion", "Remove doctor's details", "Confirm deletion"], "expected": ["Deletion confirmed"]},
  {"id": "TC-004", "title": "Maintain Chemist & Lab Details", "req_ids": ["U3"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": [], "inputs": {}, "steps": ["Present Chemist/Lab registration form", "Submit form", "Create Chemist/Lab record", "Ensure Pincode uniqueness", "View and update Chemist/Lab record", "Request deletion", "Remove Chemist/Lab record", "Confirm deletion"], "expected": ["Chemist/Lab record maintained", "Unique Pincode enforced", "Deletion confirmed"]},
  {"id": "TC-005", "title": "Add a new Chemist or Lab", "req_ids": ["U3"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": [], "inputs": {}, "steps": ["Present form", "Submit form", "Create record", "Ensure single Chemist/Lab per Pincode", "View and update record", "Request deletion", "Remove record", "Confirm deletion"], "expected": ["Record created", "Pincode uniqueness enforced", "Deletion confirmed"]},
  {"id": "TC-006", "title": "View and Update Chemist/Lab Details", "req_ids": ["U3"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": ["Chemist/Lab record displayed"], "inputs": {}, "steps": ["Submit updates", "Confirm updates"], "expected": ["Record updated", "Pincode unchanged", "Deletion confirmed"]},
  {"id": "TC-007", "title": "Ensure Doctor extraneous details cannot be updated", "req_ids": ["U12_4"], "kind": "negative", "preconditions": ["Doctor's details registered"], "inputs": {}, "steps": ["Update Speciality", "Expect rejection"], "expected": ["Update rejected"]},
  {"id": "TC-008", "title": "Delete a Chemist/Lab Details", "req_ids": ["U3"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": ["Chemist/Lab record registered", "No pending Prescription"], "inputs": {}, "steps": ["Request deletion", "Remove Chemist/Lab record", "Confirm deletion"], "expected": ["Record removed", "Pincode unchanged", "Deletion confirmed"]}
]
```

Note: The above JSON test cases are structured to match the Gherkin scenarios. The "preconditions" and "inputs" fields are simplified and may need further expansion based on the actual system' extraneous details. The "expected" fields are concrete outcomes based on the requirements provided. The "kind" field indicates the nature of the test case, which can be positive, negative, or boundary testing. The "steps" field should contain the specific actions taken during the test, which should be detailed according to the system's implementation. The "expected" field should reflect the concrete, checkable outcomes as per the requirements.
